baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins على with الأرائك at word 2 and the imperfect ينظرون at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural subjects occupy furnished beds inside bounded chambers while continuously directing sight or insight toward an unexpressed object.

activation_trace.role: The direct curtained-bed sense supplies both the physical seat and a bounded visual chamber.
Directed ocular or reflective attention supplies the occupants' ongoing perceptive act.

changed_reading.after: They inhabit a screened, furnished vantage and remain actively perceptive toward an intentionally open field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines a place-root branch of remaining fixed with a seeing-root branch of waiting or respite.
baseline_models.mechanism: Residence and expectation overlap: the couches are durable stations, and the imperfect verb can hold the occupants in an extended interval of awaiting rather than a visual instant.

activation_trace.role: Remaining fixed in a place supplies durable residence rather than a momentary posture.
Watching for a time or granting delay supplies expectancy and temporal extension to the imperfect verb.

changed_reading.before: The verse freezes a single comfortable viewing moment.
changed_reading.after: The verse can stage secure, continued residence while an awaited disclosure reaches completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural couches and plural viewers combine with an omitted object for ينظرون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The chambered seats can be arranged as a social field of mutual visibility, so the viewers need not all face one external spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Plural furnished chambers supply the separate stations from which a social geometry can form.
Facing dwellings that see one another supplies reciprocal visibility as an alternative to one-way spectatorship.

changed_reading.before: Several individuals look in the same outward direction.
changed_reading.after: The couches may compose a community whose members are mutually present and visible while also viewing outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange is an unequal comparison: full intake and deficient outflow. A focus branch of matching counterpart to counterpart turns looking into verification that the broken equation has been restored, while the closing return of recompense supplies the visible result.

activation_trace.role: Matching an equivalent with its counterpart until equality supplies an equalizing sense inside the open-ended looking.
Measuring one item against another supplies the comparison operation whose asymmetry can later be corrected.
The balance of justice supplies the norm that makes equivalence more than a merely visual resemblance.
Deliberately diminishing measure or weight supplies the precise defect that the later scene reverses.
Recompense returning to its actor supplies the completed counterpart that the viewers can apprehend.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 reverses the direction of measure, and 83:36 closes the focus scene by asking about returned action.
The object of ينظرون is omitted, leaving room for an outcome rather than only a scenic object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bilateral measure, just balance, deliberate shortfall, equal matching, and recompense returning to its doer; I infer that the unexpressed object can be the visibly equalized outcome. A live alternative is ordinary looking at delight or at the former mockers.

changed_reading.before: They look from comfort at an unspecified sight.
changed_reading.after: They witness the unequal exchange resolve into an exact returned outcome; seeing becomes verification of balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A binding record, visible inscription, present witnesses, and privileged proximity precede the first occurrence of the same couch-and-looking clause. Its repetition at the focus lets delight coexist with evidentiary certainty: the occupants see what has been fixed and attested.

activation_trace.role: Sight joined with reflective apprehension supplies the focus act as informed witnessing rather than passive staring.
An inscription that establishes judgment or decree supplies the binding object of knowledge.
A marked line in a register supplies inspectable rather than merely asserted evidence.
Presence together with seeing supplies an attesting audience for the registered outcome.
The favored inner circle near a sovereign supplies authorized proximity to what is witnessed.
The earlier identical act of apprehending binds the couch scene directly to the preceding record-and-witness sequence.

structural_cues: 83:18-21 moves from record to marked record to witnessing, and 83:23 immediately states the same clause as 83:35.
The exact clause returns after the social accusation scene, allowing the evidentiary frame to survive the intervening material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a decree-bearing record, its visible marking, present witnesses, courtly proximity, and an exact earlier couch/look clause; I infer that the repeated focus looking inherits a verification function. The live alternative is that repetition only resumes the catalogue of bliss.

changed_reading.after: Their looking is also epistemic closure: from a privileged station they apprehend an outcome already recorded and witnessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct couch sense includes a curtain, yet its occupants can look. Context separates three boundary functions: a veil that blocks access, a seal that preserves, and concealment that covers truth. The focus chamber thus becomes protected enclosure with perceptual access, not exclusion.

activation_trace.role: A bed housed inside a curtained chamber supplies an enclosure that shelters its occupants.
Active sight or insight keeps the sheltered chamber open to apprehension.
A barrier that prevents arrival supplies the contrary enclosure: separation from access.
A secured preventing seal supplies beneficial closure that preserves what will be received.
Veiling truth supplies culpable closure, sharpening the contrast with shelter that still permits sight.

structural_cues: The focus uses على for the viewers' relation to the enclosed seat, while 83:15 uses عن for barred relation.
The first identical couch/look line occurs before the preserved drink; the second occurs after concealment and reversed laughter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a curtained couch with vision, denied access behind a barrier, a preserving seal, and truth-covering; I infer a contrast among kinds of enclosure and treat the focus as selectively permeable shelter. The alternative is that the curtain is only lexical furniture detail with no contextual function.

changed_reading.before: The couches are ornate furniture in a private room.
changed_reading.after: The couches stage protected access: their occupants are enclosed without being cut off, the inverse of exclusionary veiling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mockers first see, convert sight into a doctrinal verdict, and classify the believers as lost; the next verse denies that they were commissioned as guardians. When laughter and looking reverse, the focus viewers therefore witness reversal without inheriting the earlier claim to police or classify others.

activation_trace.role: The watcher who both sees and guards activates a possible supervisory register for the focus verb.
Direct sight or insight supplies the earlier gaze from which a hostile judgment is launched.
Speech as belief or doctrine supplies the conversion of seeing into an asserted worldview.
Departure from right guidance supplies the accusatory category imposed by the earlier viewers.
Guarding and custodial care name the very authority that the verse's negation withholds from the mockers.
Joy or astonishment visibly expressed in laughter supplies affective reversal without itself granting custody.

structural_cues: 83:33 places an explicit negation of commissioned guardianship between the mockers' verdict and the reversal of laughter.
The object of the focus looking remains unstated, so reversal need not mean symmetrical condemnation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile seeing, a spoken classification, an explicit denial of guardianship, and reversed laughter; I infer that the watcher branch is activated and then constrained, making the later gaze noncustodial. A live alternative is direct retaliatory spectatorship over the former mockers.

changed_reading.before: The believers simply take over the supervisory gaze once held by their mockers.
changed_reading.after: They see the reversal without inheriting false authority to classify or police; witnessing and laughter coexist with noncustodiality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mockers pass by, turn back to their people, and finally receive action returning to them. Against that circulation, the focus roots combine fixed residence with expectant looking: the righteous occupy a durable station while the transient circuit completes itself.

activation_trace.role: Staying fixed without departing supplies the stable pole of the passage's movement pattern.
Waiting for a time supplies duration while the return sequence reaches its end.
Passing and moving onward supply the mockers' transient relation to those they ridicule.
Turning away and returning supply the repeated homeward loop that contrasts with settled residence.
Return to a place or state supplies closure of the spatial circuit around the stationary viewers.
A deed's recompense returning to its actor turns the spatial circuit into a moral one.

structural_cues: The repeated reciprocal winking in 83:30 has no branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue inside the pass-by episode.
83:31 repeats the same turning verb twice, whereas 83:35 gives a locative posture rather than another movement verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passing, doubled return, fixed residence, waiting, and recompense returning; I infer that physical movement diagrams a moral-temporal circuit completed under the viewers' gaze. The live alternative is that the travel verbs are ordinary narrative movement unrelated to the later seating.

changed_reading.before: The couches describe comfortable posture at one instant.
changed_reading.after: They mark durable residence from which the righteous await a return circuit: transient mockery goes home and the deed finally comes home to its doer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch concerns a look leaving a visible color or mark rather than the verb's ordinary act of seeing. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the recognition-face-radiance sequence immediately after the identical line at 83:23. Render it as an exploratory feedback image, not as a claim that looking physically causes radiance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ينظرون at word 3 can activate the branch in which a gaze registers visibly on appearance.

activation_trace.role: A gaze leaving a visible effect in color or condition supplies the possibility that seeing registers on the viewer.
Recognition through a sign or trace supplies the legibility of the viewers' altered condition.
The face as the forward visible surface supplies the bodily site on which the condition appears.
Freshness and luminous beauty supply the visible effect recognized on that surface.

changed_reading.before: Looking travels outward from comfortable viewers to an object.
changed_reading.after: Looking participates in a feedback field: what is apprehended is also legible as radiance upon the viewers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary couch branch, not the wound branch, governs the noun in context. It remains anchored in the same focus root and gains material support from ease, radiance, and release from constriction. Render it only as a convalescent analogy: settled injury becoming sound, not a replacement translation of الأرائك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأرائك at word 2 shares a branch inventory with a wound settling after repair.

activation_trace.role: A wound quieting as healthy tissue appears supplies a material analogy of settled repair for the resting station.
Softness, ease, and untroubled living supply the recovered condition into which the occupants settle.
Fresh radiance supplies the visible sign of soundness after the wound analogy's subsiding.
Expansion that relieves constriction supplies the transition from social pressure to ease.

changed_reading.before: The couch scene signals luxury after hardship.
changed_reading.after: It can also image convalescence: injury and constriction have subsided into stable, visibly sound repose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and branch-distant because the direct lexical reading is curtained couches and the righteous are not being renamed as fruit. It remains traceable because the focus root carries an arak-tree branch while the contextual righteous-root carries an arak-fruit branch, with a spring and drinking completing an ecological cluster. Render it as a secondary grove or material overlay that coexists with, and never replaces, the furniture reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأرائك at word 2 directly denotes couches but also activates the focus root's arak-tree branch.

activation_trace.role: The direct curtained-couch sense remains the governing furniture layer that contains the outlier.
The arak tree supplies a latent grove material beside the noun's direct couch sense.
Arak fruit supplies a second independent branch contact that turns the tree image into a contextual cluster.
A flowing water source supplies the grove's ecological water element.
Taking in liquid supplies inhabited use of the spring rather than decorative landscape alone.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents only an interior furnished chamber.
changed_reading.after: A contained ecological overlay appears within the chamber scene: couches resonate with arak growth, fruit, spring, and drinking.

strongest_changes: Looking becomes verification of exact returned balance, joining the opening short measure to closing recompense.
The repeated couch-and-looking clause inherits the record-and-witness frame, so visual delight and evidentiary certainty coexist.
Settled couches answer the mockers' pass-and-return circuit with durable residence while deeds return to their actors.
The curtained couch becomes protected enclosure with access, sharply unlike exclusionary veiling.
summary.what_was_special: Two focus roots generated unusually many coexisting mechanisms: chambered sight, waiting, mutual visibility, equalization, and fixed residence. Exact repetition at 83:23 lets record, radiance, drink, hostile gaze, reversal, and recompense reactivate the same compact clause; the arak grove and healed-wound branches remain live as contained material overlays.
remaining_uncertainties: The omitted object of looking can remain delights, records, an equalized outcome, former mockers, or a mutually visible community.
The equal-matching, wound, gaze-imprint, and arak-tree readings are branch-distant and should coexist with direct sight and couch senses rather than displace them.
The proposed arrows from seeing to facial radiance and from movement verbs to a moral return circuit are reader inferences, not explicit causal syntax.
